two_queue_timeline_ms_per_token.note: Inclusive family and kernel sums double-count simultaneous work on the primary and shared-expert queues; interval union is the actual device-busy wall proxy.

change_from_post_router_wave0_census.qualification: The post-router census was single-queue and predates retained overlap. Union-busy/span comparisons use the retained pre-F16 overlap trace, not its single-queue kernel sum.

protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 HIPENGINE_LAGUNA_F16_DECODE=fixedk PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-f16-nt-census.pgi5uZ --output-file current -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-f16-nt-census.pgi5uZ/bench.json
protocol.segmentation: sort by start timestamp and dispatch id; discard warmup128 and timed prefill512; report medians over the final 127 length-one embedding-through-argmax segments; merge overlapping kernel intervals across both queues for union-busy time

interpretation.result: The retained non-temporal source-F16 direction transfers to the integrated two-queue route and current aggregate GPU work is already below the Vulkan comparator.
interpretation.primary_bottleneck: hipEngine remains slower in clean wall despite lower union-busy device work; host submission, dependency placement, and cross-queue memory contention are the leading remaining mechanisms.
interpretation.next_screen: Move the existing shared-branch record/wait point after selected gate/up so shared gate/down overlaps selected down without adding an event, launch, resident allocation, or arithmetic change.
